purpose: śrī 3 sveṣṭadevatā prītyarthaṃ pāṣāṇanirmmita vāpī prāsāda tad upari suvarṇṇakalaśa dhvajāvarohaṇa siddhāgni ayutāhuti yajña navapīṭha aṣṭamātṛkā ārādhānārthaṃ
notes: Bhūpatīndra Malla ruled Bhaktapur (r. 1696–1722 CE). The colophon mentions his performance of an ayutāhuti sacrifice and dedication of a pond, temple, and golden finial, but gives no date or place name directly.
